title: Prejudice or affect the general application
description: The mention of particular matters in sub-section (2) does not prejudice the general application of section 6 of the General Clauses Act, 1897

content.general_rule: The general application of section 6 of the General Clauses Act, 1897 applies
content.exception: The mention of particular matters in sub-section (2) shall not be held to prejudice or affect it
